faq.q: How do I get from the yacht to the Starlite venue?
faq.a: Our standard packages include a private transfer from Puerto Banús to the Auditorio in Nagüeles (about 15 minutes). After the concert, your driver will return you to the marina. If you prefer, you can walk from the port to the shuttle bus stop at the Golden Mile – but we recommend the seamless VIP transfer.

faq.q: Can I watch the concert from the boat?
faq.a: No, Starlite is held at the Auditorio in Nagüeles, which is inland and not visible from the coast. The yacht charter is for a pre-concert cruise (sunset, drinks, dinner) and a post-concert return. You attend the concert itself at the venue.

faq.q: Which yachts are best for a Starlite combo?
faq.a: For a couple or small group, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are ideal. For a larger party, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) or Ferretti 94 (pricing on request) offer space for up to 12 guests. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Tier B boats also include a free jet ski. No hidden extras.

faq.q: How long does the pre-concert cruise take?
faq.a: Most guests book a 2-hour sunset cruise (e.g., 6pm–8pm) followed by the transfer to Starlite. If you want a longer day on the water, an 8-hour charter (€2,299 for Tier A) allows time for a coastal trip to Cabopino or Estepona before the concert.

faq.q: Can I book a yacht for just the day and skip the concert?
faq.a: Absolutely. You don't have to attend Starlite. Many guests charter a yacht for a full day cruise to Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or Sotogrande. Just let us know your plans and we'll tailor the itinerary.

faq.q: Is there a minimum number of guests for the charter?
faq.a: No minimum, but capacity limits apply: e.g., Astondoa 40 (9 pax), Azimut 39 (11 pax), Mangusta 80 (12 pax). For smaller groups, the Dubhe (5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are available – pricing on request.

faq.q: How do I book a marbella yacht charter starlite 2032 combo?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing for your chosen date. We'll confirm the yacht, departure time, and transfer details. Book early – Starlite tickets sell out fast, and our popular boats go quickly in July and August.

data.body_html:
Starlite 2032 returns to Marbella with its signature mix of international music, gastronomy, and glamour. For those who want to elevate the experience, a marbella yacht charter starlite 2032 combo offers the ultimate evening: a sunset cruise from Puerto Banús, followed by VIP access to the concert, and a relaxed return to the marina. This guide covers everything you need to know to plan your night – from boat options and pricing to logistics and FAQs.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for Starlite 2032?

Starlite is held at the Auditorio in Nagüeles, just 15 minutes from Puerto Banús. A yacht charter adds a layer of luxury to your night: you avoid traffic, enjoy a private pre-concert cruise along the Marbella coastline, and return to the marina for late-night drinks or dinner. The combination of sea, sunset, and live music is hard to beat. Our charters include a skipper, drinks, snacks, and transfers – so you can focus on the experience.

Our Yacht Fleet for Starlite 2032

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús. Choose based on group size, budget, and desired amenities. Below is a selection of popular options; for the full fleet, see our Boat Rental Marbella hub.

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) include a free jet ski. For other boats, contact us via WhatsApp.

How the Combo Works: Step by Step

  1. Book your yacht and Starlite tickets – We can advise on availability; tickets sold separately.
  2. Departure from Puerto Banús – Typically 2–3 hours before the concert. Cruise along the coast towards Cabopino or Estepona, enjoying drinks and snacks.
  3. Transfer to the venue – Our driver meets you at the marina and takes you to Nagüeles (15 min).
  4. Concert at Starlite 2032 – Enjoy the show. The venue offers bars and dining options.
  5. Return to Puerto Banús – After the concert, your driver takes you back to the marina. You can continue the night at a beach club or restaurant.

Pricing and Options for Every Budget

For a couple or small group, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 at €749/2h is the most cost-effective way to combine a cruise with Starlite. If you want a full day on the water, the 8-hour rate (€2,299) lets you explore the coast before the concert. For a larger party, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) offers space and a jet ski. Premium yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86 are available on request – ideal for VIP groups.

Best Itineraries for a Starlite Evening

Most guests opt for a sunset cruise from 6pm to 8pm, heading west towards Estepona or east to Cala del Faro. The light on La Concha mountain is spectacular. After the concert, return to Puerto Banús for a late dinner at one of the Golden Mile restaurants. If you have a full-day charter, consider a morning trip to Cabopino beach, lunch at a chiringuito, and a siesta before the evening events.
